newsitem.title: USA: Seitel sees Q4 earnings "up significantly".
newsitem.headline: Seitel sees Q4 earnings "up significantly".

text.p: Seitel Inc said Wednesday it had record revenues in the 1996 fourth quarter of more than $26 million, up from $17.8 million a year ago.

The seismic-technology company also said that while 1996 earnings have not been finalized, "results for the fourth quarter were also up significantly and growth for the full year should be greater than the approximate 40 percent jump in revenue."
The company will report fully audited year-end results in March.

"Seitel's revenue for 1996, for the first time, reached and surpassed the $100 million mark -- totalling over $103 million," said Paul Frame, president and chief executive. In 1995 Seitel had record revenues of $74.4 million.
In the 1995 fourth quarter Seitel had income from continuing operations of $2.0 million, equal to $0.20 per share.
Frame said 1996 growth was fueled by strong seismic business and accelerating oil and gas production.
